acceptance.requirement: current package owns real inventory, observation, and cleanup runtime
unowned post-baseline resources fail closed before cleanup
terminal, slot, and lease transitions require a verified machine cleanup receipt
ordinary internal red cycles retain one attempt/worktree/slot/writer and first failure
clean owned worktree/process/port/temp/lock/lease cleanup uses real observation and git prune
dirty worktree quarantines and blocks force delete, delivery, and lease release
baseline/external worktrees, branches, and temporary roots are never removed
leader exit, descendants, ports, and real locks require machine post-observation
stopped Docker resource is not removed and cannot be clean
crash/retry recovery retains dirty candidates, external resources, and ownership separation
#1817 ledger, #1818 dispatch receipt, and #1821 epoch bind resource state transitions
group/member cleanup retains group resources until bound group cleanup
two repositories and shared workspace retain unrelated metadata/resources
cleanup receipt has all required machine-observed fields and self-consistent digest
